page: Amazon Web Services g6e.8xlarge is an accelerated computing instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. The instance features an AMD EPYC 7R13 x86_64 processor clocked at 3.4 GHz, providing 32 dedicated virtual CPUs across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. Memory allocation is substantial at 256.0 GB of DDR4 RAM operating at 3 GHz, providing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. In addition to high system memory, the instance integrates 900 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network throughput of 25 Gbps.

Hardware acceleration is driven by a single NVIDIA L40S GPU built on the Ada Lovelace architecture, featuring 45 GB of dedicated VRAM. In benchmark testing, this accelerator achieves top-tier results in large language model inference, placing in the top 10 percent for prompt processing and text generation across small, medium, and 70-billion parameter models. Host compute testing reflects strong single-core performance in stress-ng and top-quartile PassMark encryption throughput, supported by hardware AES and SHA instruction flags, while general multi-core compute and web serving throughput align with median cloud infrastructure benchmarks.

The dense pairing of 45 GB GPU memory, 256 GB of system RAM, and 900 GB NVMe SSD local storage delivers high resource consolidation within a single node. While DDR4 memory bandwidth and general multi-core CPU metrics remain mid-range, the instance offers strong cost efficiency for GPU-bound AI workloads compared to deploying multi-GPU systems. AWS g6e.8xlarge is optimized for large language model inference, graphics-intensive rendering, video processing pipelines, and data-heavy machine learning workflows requiring fast local scratch storage.
description: Amazon Web Services g6e.8xlarge is an accelerated computing instance powered by a 3.4 GHz AMD EPYC 7R13 processor featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs, 16 physical cores, and 256.0 GB of DDR4 memory. Built on the AWS Nitro system, it includes a dedicated NVIDIA L40S GPU with 45 GB of Ada Lovelace VRAM, 900 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage, and 25 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark evaluations highlight top-tier performance in large language model inference across small, medium, and 70B parameter models, complemented by strong CPU encryption and single-core compute. While system memory throughput and multi-core processing align with standard mid-tier benchmarks, the high ratio of system RAM and fast local storage per GPU delivers efficient resource density. This instance is designed for generative AI inference, computer vision, 3D graphics rendering, and data pipelines requiring accelerated compute and local disk cache.
